top_signals.title: Barclays Says US 30-Year Yield Can Reach 6% in Productivity Boom
top_signals.summary: The US 30-year yield has scope to reach 6% as this month’s Treasury market selloff has yet to price in the risk of a sustained increase in productivity growth, the head of US rates research at Barclays Capital said in a report.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: European Stocks Erase Gains as Selloff in US Bond Market Resumes
top_signals.summary: European stocks were little changed on Tuesday as US Treasuries drove a risk-off end to the day, while Julius Baer Group Ltd. rose after Swiss regulatory action against the bank ended.
